text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy runs in the Teio Sho<n>with all her heart.
The day she fully<n>realizes her wild ambitions is
drawing<n>ever closer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like her notoriety is spreading<n>across news
sites, with them labeling<n>her "a beast of the dirt."
But she<n>wants to strike even greater fear into<n>their
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is the Champions Cup.<n>It's a big G1
race that draws a huge<n>crowd, so a win there will
be sure to<n>generate even more buzz.
